{{Quote|Welcome to the Stenness Spaceport. Docking facilities are located on levels twenty-three, twenty-four, and twenty-five. Food troughs are located on levels fifty through fifty-three. Brothels are located on levels fifty-four through one thousand.|[[Stenness Hyperspace Terminal]] announcer|audio=StennessAnnouncer.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
A '''brothel''', sometimes called a '''bordello''', was a building where the business of [[Prostitute/Legends|prostitution]] took place. [[Madame Lota's House of Flowers]] was a brothel on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].
